paragraphs: Tom's Diary, Sunday evening. Dear diary, Last week, I became a member of the school cycle group. This morning, I woke up early, and I put water and a hat in my bag. Today was our first ride, and I was very excited. Every child has a partner, so nobody rides alone. My partner was Ben.

We left the school gate at eight o'clock. We rode in two lines, and Ben rode in front of me. First, we cycled along the river for two kilometers. "Slow down at the bridge," said Coach Matt. Then we turned left at the bridge. After that, we went straight on to the lake. The road was flat and quiet, and the air was cool. The water in the river was brown and slow. Coach Matt rode at the back to look after the group. I liked the ride, because I like to be outside in the morning. Two small birds sat on the bridge and watched us.

At the lake, Ben saw a brown wallet on the path. Nobody was near the lake. We opened it and looked inside. There were four things in it, including a small photo of a girl. It also had two notes and a card. We did not take anything out of it. "We must find the owner," said Ben. "Let's take it to the park office," I said. Coach Matt agreed, and the whole group walked with us.

A woman in the office looked at the card and made a phone call. Ten minutes later, a man ran into the office. "That is my wallet!" he said. "The girl in the photo is my daughter." He said thank you three times. Ben and I felt proud. Afterwards, we sat on the grass and drank water. "Good job, partners," said Coach Matt.

The ride back took one hour. My legs were tired, but I felt happy. I think that I will sleep very well tonight. Tomorrow, I will tell Mom about the wallet. I will cycle with Ben again next Sunday. Do you like to cycle? Good night, diary.
text.summary: In his diary, Tom writes about the first ride of the school cycle group. He and Ben follow the river to a lake, find a wallet on the path, and take it to the park office.
